content: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used in machine learning and optimization to minimize the loss function by iteratively moving towards the minimum of the function. It works by calculating the gradient of the loss function with respect to the parameters of the model and updating these parameters in the opposite direction of the gradient, in order to minimize the loss. Gradient descent is a popular and widely used algorithm in various machine learning models such as neural networks, linear regression, and logistic regression.
